cohort: Neonates born in 33 sub-Saharan African countries between 2010 and 2018, whose births were recorded in nationally representative Demographic and Health Surveys.
finding: There was a statistically significant increase in the odds of neonatal mortality after a caesarean section (OR 1.7) compared to normal deliveries.
mod_finding: Children delivered via caesarean section were 70% more likely not to survive beyond the first 30 days compared to those delivered normally.
